name: 一日の学習目標
prompt:
Create ONE isolated Japanese daily-learning-goal card. Input1 ORIGINAL Coursera screenshot is PRIMARY authority for empty-checkbox anatomy, corner radii, border optical weight, alignment, proportions, spacing and fine details. Input2 Japanese native mock is SECONDARY for exact Japanese wording and locked text roles. Input3 approved Lighthouse finish only; do not include bus content. Only source region x48 y1082 width1082 height320 in1179x2676.
Pure WHITE390x120 logical canvas with compact card atx16,y6,width358,height108,cornerRadius8, white fill, fine neutral #E4E4E4 outline1. Flat precise UI raster, high resolution, no device/browser/staging scene. No extra panels, no added labels.
Heading exact「一日の学習目標」atx32,y16, Meiryo Bold70014px line24, zero letter spacing, dark #1D1D1D. Below, empty rounded-square checkbox atx32,y64,26x26,corner4,whitefill,fine neutral outline. It is UNCHECKED despite partial completion1/3. Match original's soft rounded empty control, not a checkmark, play icon or switch.
Goal text exact TWO lines atx76,y54,width230:「講義・読書・問題を」then「合わせて3つ終える」. Meiryo Bold70014px line24, zero spacing,dark. Keep compact line breaks and source checkbox-left/text-right hierarchy. Far right exact「1 / 3」atx316,y68,width46, right-aligned Meiryo REGULAR40012px line16, zero spacing,dark. The count is light regular weight, visibly less heavy than title and goal. Source English bold count is intentionally adapted to the locked Japanese Regular12 role.
WHITE ordinary card, neutral hairline borders, NO green/tinted background, NO highlighted or completed state, NO shadow emphasis, no additional accent needed. Maintain white margins, clean readable hierarchy, source geometry and precise two-line Japanese copy.
reviewNotes: Original empty checkbox/neutral card anatomy retained, Japanese two-line goal correct, count1 / 3 lighter Regular role. White surfaces and neutral borders. Static raster visual inspection only; no native/app/owner acceptance.
